purpose: check the variance model and fire K1-K4 before the full budget is committed

design.configurations: all 24 of production/campaign_plan.json, which contains every configuration carrying an unresolved cell

mandatory_coverage.role: t1p5 SR unresolved, historically worst concentration
t1p5 SR unresolved, the only cells where Route B missed r*

design.seeds: the frozen campaign-plan seeds; Stage-0 uses block indices 0..19, and Stage 1 continues at block index 20, so no path is ever drawn twice and no block is discarded

stage0_verdict_rule.STAGE0_KILLED: K1, K2 or K9 fired. These are trusted-computing-base failures: the analytic contract disagrees with quadrature, the alarm bounds disagree with the frozen detector, or the producer gate failed. The campaign aborts and no estimator is redesigned inside this result-bearing campaign.
stage0_verdict_rule.STAGE0_INCONCLUSIVE: any of the four configurations carrying an unresolved cell was killed by K3 or K4. The residue cannot be addressed within the frozen budget, so the campaign stops without a full run.
stage0_verdict_rule.STAGE0_PASS: no K1/K2/K9 failure, and all four unresolved-residue configurations survived K3 and K4. Configurations outside the residue that were killed carry forward and their cells are reported INCONCLUSIVE in the full run; they do not block Stage-0.

what_stage0_may_do: falsify feasibility, kill a configuration, exclude a configuration on cost
what_stage0_may_not_do: alter the block count or path count
alter the worker or thread configuration
cause an estimator redesign inside this campaign
stage0_does_not_read: whether a cell is close to passing
